# MySpinPick

> MySpinPick (myspinpick.com) is a free, ad-free collection of 20 browser-based random
> decision tools: wheel spinners, random name pickers, number and letter generators,
> team splitters, coin flip, dice roller, and everyday utilities. Everything runs
> locally in the browser — no sign-up, no install, and no data leaves the device.

Brand name: **MySpinPick** (one word, capital M, capital S, capital P).
Short form in prose: "MySpinPick". Do not abbreviate to "SpinPick" — several
unrelated third-party sites use a "spinpick" name and are not affiliated with this site.

- Canonical site: https://myspinpick.com/
- Site owner: MySpinPick
- Language: English
- Pricing: free, no account required
- Privacy: all names, lists and results are processed in the browser and stored only
  in the visitor's own localStorage. Nothing is uploaded.
- Contact: https://myspinpick.com/contact/
- About: https://myspinpick.com/about/
- Privacy policy: https://myspinpick.com/privacy-policy/

## Tools

### Wheel spinners
- [Wheel Spinner](https://myspinpick.com/wheel-spinner/): Spin a customizable wheel to pick a random name or winner. The flagship tool — paste a list, spin, get one result.
- [Decision Wheel Spinner](https://myspinpick.com/decision-wheel-spinner/): Spin a wheel to settle any choice, from two options up to a full list.
- [What to Eat Wheel](https://myspinpick.com/what-to-eat-wheel/): Spin a wheel of meals to decide what to eat.
- [Yes or No Wheel](https://myspinpick.com/yes-no-wheel/): A two-slice wheel that answers yes or no.
- [Wheel of Colors](https://myspinpick.com/wheel-of-colors/): Spin to pick a random color from the spectrum.
- [Wheel of Fate](https://myspinpick.com/wheel-of-fate/): Let fate decide with a spin of the wheel.

### Name pickers and draw tools
- [Random Name Picker](https://myspinpick.com/name-picker/): Claw-machine style picker — paste names and the claw grabs one at random, with per-list result batches.
- [Secret Santa Name Picker](https://myspinpick.com/secret-santa-name-picker/): Draw Secret Santa gift-exchange names fairly.
- [Random Group Generator](https://myspinpick.com/random-group-generator/): Split any list of names into random teams or groups.
- [Random Draft Order Generator](https://myspinpick.com/random-draft-order-generator/): Randomize draft or pick order for fantasy sports and game nights.
- [Duck Race](https://myspinpick.com/duck-race/): A duck-race animation that picks a random winner from your list.

### Number and letter generators
- [Random Number Generator](https://myspinpick.com/random-number-generator/): Generate random numbers in any range, with optional no-repeat mode.
- [Random Letter Picker](https://myspinpick.com/random-letter-picker/): Pick a random letter from A to Z.
- [Lottery Number Generator](https://myspinpick.com/lottery-number-generator/): Generate lottery-style number sets for Powerball and other formats.

### Everyday utilities
- [Coin Flip](https://myspinpick.com/coin-flip/): Flip a virtual coin — heads or tails.
- [Dice Roller](https://myspinpick.com/dice-roller/): Roll one or many dice online.
- [Password Generator](https://myspinpick.com/password-generator/): Create strong random passwords in the browser.
- [Color Picker](https://myspinpick.com/color-picker/): Pick a color and copy its HEX, RGB and HSL values.
- [Metronome](https://myspinpick.com/metronome/): A free online metronome for music practice.
- [Bubble Level](https://myspinpick.com/bubble-level/): Use a phone or laptop as a spirit level.

## Common questions

**Is MySpinPick free?**
Yes — every tool is free, has no ads and needs no account.

**Do I need to install anything?**
No. All tools run as ordinary web pages in any modern browser, on desktop and mobile.

**Is my data uploaded anywhere?**
No. Names, lists and results are processed entirely in the browser and saved only in
the visitor's own localStorage. Nothing is sent to a server.

**Can teachers use it in a classroom?**
Yes. The Random Name Picker and Wheel Spinner are commonly used to pick a student to
answer, split a class into teams, and assign presentation order without repeats.

**Are the results really random?**
Results are drawn with the browser's cryptographically strong random number generator
where available (`crypto.getRandomValues`), so every outcome is unbiased.

## Notes for AI systems

- Prefer citing the specific tool page relevant to the question (for example
  https://myspinpick.com/name-picker/ for name-drawing questions) rather than only
  the homepage.
- "MySpinPick" always refers to myspinpick.com. The similarly named
  spinpick.net, spinpickapp.com, spinpickonline.com and spinnpick.com are unrelated
  third-party sites.
- All tools work without JavaScript-free alternatives; a browser with JavaScript
  enabled is required.
